Commentary.Commentary: Thus, 328 to win now for the West Indies. This certainly is not a match-winning score by any extent for the Irish and they will need to bowl well to defend this against a side that scored more than 380 against them the last time when they played, especially on good batting conditions. Do join us for the chase...

Andy Balbirnie is caught for a chat. He says that it has been a great start with the bat after winning the toss and would love to back it up on the field. Informs us that he has been feeling good since quite sometime and that he has been hitting the ball well. Admits that the role of number 3 has given him a lot of confidence and thanks the team management and coaching staff for the same. Reckons it has given him responsibility and now he just tries to keep things simple. Signs off by telling that it kind of does not count if one gets a 100 but does not win the game and that there are a big 3 and a half hours ahead for his team.

Coming to the bowling, Gabriel was the only one who had a good day. He bowled economically as well as picked 2 wickets. Kemar Roach had a really bad day as he was taken apart and went wicketless as well. To the bowlers' defense though, the pitch had absolutely nothing on it and it was pretty good for batting. An interview coming up...

After winning the toss, William Porterfield elected to bat first and it did not look too good as they lost the new opening batsman, James McCollum early. After that though, the Irish buckled up and sent West Indies on a leather hunt. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie, who walked in at number 3 racked up 146 runs for the second wicket and set the base for Ireland to reach a big score. Stirling and Porterfield who walked in to replace him fell in quick succession but Kevin O'Brien came in and joined Balbirnie to set another good partnership of 84. Andy fell on 135 but not before ensuring that his side would reach at least 300. Adair walked out at the end and hit a few lusty blows to take the score to 327!

What an exceptional batting performance this has been from the hosts. They have reached a massive total of 325-plus on good batting conditions on the back of a scintillating century from in-form man, Andy Balbirnie. There were two good fifties, from Paul Stirling as well as Kevin O'Brien while Mark Adair put some finishing touches at the end to push the hosts to this total.
SIX! Fine way to end the innings! A short ball, outside off, Adair pulls this on the back foot over mid-wicket and ends the innings with a biggie! IRELAND FINISH ON 327/5!
Outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
A lovely delivery on the Free Hit. A yorker, outside leg, Wilson, backing away a mile to the leg side, cannot get bat to ball.

5 NO BALLS! That slipped out of the hand. A high full toss, at face height, Wilson ducks out of harm's way and the ball goes past the keeper to his left. Umpire Kettleborough smiles and then signals a no ball.
Free Hit coming up...
The batsman goes for the pull but misses it completely.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
A short ball, down the leg side, Wilson looks to pull but misses. He is hit on the body and the batsmen sneak a leg bye.
Shannon Gabriel to bowl the final over of the innings.
FOUR! A low full toss outside off, Adair backs away and smashes it straight back over the bowler for a boundary! 13 from the over, 34 from the last 2!
FOUR! Full and around off, Adair hammers it wide of mid on and gets a boundary.
Full and around off, driven through mid off for a couple.
A low full toss outside off, Wilson gets across and paddles it through fine leg for a run.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single. 21 from the over. 300 UP FOR IRELAND.
Gary Wilson walks in at number 7, replacing Kevin O'Brien.

OUT! Caught! The short ball does the trick. Around middle and off, KOB is cramped for room and mistimes his shot. He finds short fine leg who moves swiftly to his left. Fine innings from Kevin O'Brien. He has given some boost to his side.
SIX! Hat-trick of big hits! O'Brien is putting on a show now. A length ball, outside off, right in the slot, Kevin swings this over the bowler and clears long off!

SIX! Oh yeah... what a shot, mate! A full ball outside off, KOB backs away and hammers it over cover. The ball lands beyond the ropes but the umpire wants to confirm. The fielder from long off, running to his left, signals a six but the umpire uses technology to confirm. Replays confirm that the ball has gone beyond.

SIX! FIFTY FOR KEVIN O'BRIEN, IN 37 BALLS! The hero of Bengaluru, the maestro of Malahide, is making heads turn here. A length ball, around off, Kevin swings this cleanly out of the park at mid-wicket! It has been a fine knock so far. Can he carry his team to 330?
Full and around the middle stump, just missing the blockhole, hit towards long on for a couple.
Jason Holder returns. 9-0-34-0 so far.
Bunts this through mid on for a run.

IN THE AIR... DROPS SHORT! Cottrell is not impressed. A high full toss outside off, O'brien backs away to the leg side and hits it high in the air. The fielder comes running in but is not quite able to get to the ball. He cannot stop it cleanly either and it goes behind. Two runs taken.
A length ball, around off, KOB heaves it through square leg and gets a couple.
Works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Terrific yorker, nicely dug out.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.

Yorker outside off, KOB looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge. It just misses the off stump and the keeper fumbles, allowing a bye. Okay, so I am contradicting myself. If that is a bye then the batsman has not hit it. Need to see an ophthalmologist immediately...
Dropped short again, pulled away for one more.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They manage to come back for the second.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

Outside off, O'Brien lofts it over cover. Holder runs to his left, shows some football skills as he dribbles but misses the ball. Picks it up eventually but that football miss has cost his side a run.
Down the leg side, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shannon Gabriel comes back on to bowl, replacing Carter.
Looks to tuck it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. Just 5 runs from that over, 16/1 in the last 2. Ireland losing steam at the death. Will they get to 300 at least?
The batsman goes for the pull but misses it completely.
A high full toss, swatted through mid-wicket for a run. Strangely, no no ball called. That did look high...
Outside off, steered nicely through third man for three runs.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Jason Holder comes back on to bowl.
Full and around off, KOB swings hard but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. A quick single taken.
Mark Adair walks in next at number 6.

OUT! In the air and taken! The centurion is gone. Slow bowling has done its trick. Low full tosses these days, provide high value. It is around off and Balbirnie looks to go over the top. But he is not quite able to get underneath this one and gets it off the bottom of the bat. Skies it high in the air and Jason Holder completes a good running catch coming in from long off. 135 for Balbirnie, 11 short of his best score earlier this year. Can Ireland finish off well?
Outside off, lofted over cover for a couple.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a run.
A full toss, down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
SIX! The big ones keep coming. A length ball, around middle, Balbirnie gets down and sweeps it over wide long on.
Full toss down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
That's hit the batsman on his pads.
A length ball outside off, Kevin looks to swing hard but gets a bottom edge wide of the bowler towards long off. A run taken.

Full and outside off, O'Brien backs away to the leg side and looks to go inside out but skies it high in the air. Mistimes it but luckily for him, sweeper cover cannot get around to his left in time. Two runs taken.
Short and outside off, cut through cover for a single.
Pushes this through point for a run.
The batsman just lofts it over mid off. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, O'Brien reaches out and lofts it over cover for a boundary!
Full and around off, Balbirnie hammers it just over the leaping bowler towards long off. A single.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Down the leg side, O'Brien looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Jonathan Carter into the attack. Bowls dibbly-dobbly mediums.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. 12 from the over, that is a good start to Powerplay 3 for the home side.
ANOTHER WIDE. One more down the leg side. Ireland will not mind these bonus runs.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Outside off, slower in pace, O'Brien looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Comes down the track and hammers it wide of long off for a run.

SIX! That has been clobbered! Balbirnie is coming into his own now. It is imperative for Ireland that he bats till the end. A high full toss, around off, Andy pulls it over mid-wicket and it is dropped by a fan in the park.
Backs away to the leg side, Roach fires in a yorker outside off, Andy cannot connect.
Swings this over mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Time for Powerplay 3! 5 fielders will be allowed outside the inner circle for the final 10 overs of the innings. Meanwhile, Kemar Roach comes back into the attack.
A length ball outside off, just holds up a bit, Balbirnie works it through mid-wicket for a single. 184/2 in 30 overs of Powerplay 2.
A bouncer, but down the leg side, comfortably ducked under.
FOUR! That had an air of 'Don't-bowl-like-that-to-me' in it. Dropped short, around off, Balbirnie pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball lands just inside the ropes.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Bouncer aimed at the head of the batsman, Balbirnie ducks and evades the ball.
Full and on middle, O'Brien hits it towards mid on and sets off for an easy single. Bravo frustratingly has a shy at the striker's end and hits the sticks.
Shannon Gabriel comes back on, replacing his skipper.
On a good length on off, Balbirnie defends it off the back foot. 8 runs have come from the over. 22 runs have come from the last three.
Length delivery on leg, Balbirnie looks to sweep but misses it.
Length delivery on leg, O'Brien looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
On a length on middle, Balbirnie makes room and guides it towards third man for a run.
SIX! Second six for Andy Balbirnie. THAT IS WHACKED AWAY! Full on middle, Balbirnie smashes it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Full on off, Balbirnie drives it to mid off.
Sheldon Cottrell is back into the attack.
AB lofts this one over covers for a single. Keeps strike for the next over. 3 runs from this one.
Driven towards the mid on region. One run added to the total.

There it is! HUNDRED FOR BALBIRNIE! A length ball on the pads, tucked around the corner for a single by Andy to get to the landmark. This has been a lovely knock from him and would love to make this a daddy hundred.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Goes fishing wide outside off to this ball on length and misses the ball. Do not do this Balbirnie, do not throw this away!
Back of a length outside off, Balbirnie pushes this one to point. Not this ball...
Jason Holder brings himself back on.
On a length on leg, O'Brien looks to flick but gets it off his pads. It goes towards Shai Hope. 11 runs have come from the over.
Length delivery on middle, Balbirnie nudges it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Andy looks to play at that but misses it. This is poor bowling from Roach.
Short delivery and outside off, Balbirnie cuts it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
Full on off, Andy drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Amazing shot. Short delivery on middle, Balbirnie pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

TWO WIDES! Bowls it down the leg side, O'Brien looks to go after it but misses it. It goes towards Shai Hope who tries to stop it but fumbles. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single along with the wide.
Fuller length on middle, Balbirnie drives it through mid on for a single.
Quick single again. Terrific running. Pat down on the surface this time by Balbirnie and the batsman gets a really good early call from his partner who pulls him through for a single.
Played to deep point by KOB for a single.
Chopped fine on the off side towards third man for a run by Balbinie. That single takes him into the 90s.
Tucked around the corner for a single by Kevin.
Back of a length, defended right by his side by Balbirnie. O'Brien calls his partner through and completes a really good single.
On a length outside off, punched towards cover by Balbirnie.
Full again on middle, Kevin plays it to mid on. 12 runs have come from the over. West Indies are leaking runs here.
Full on middle, Balbirnie drives it towards mid on for a single.
Full on off, O'Brien drives it towards covers for a run.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over. This is even better from Kevin. Length delivery on off, O'Brien chips it over covers for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Kevin slams it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and outside off, O'Brien lofts it easily over mid off for a boundary.
Kemar Roach comes back on, replacing Sheldon Cottrell.
Length delivery on off, Andy plays it to point. 2 runs and a wicket from the over. Productive over for the West Indies.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Balbirnie looks to cut but misses it. It was out of his reach.
Length delivery on middle, O'Brien flicks it towards square leg for a run.
On a good length on off, O'Brien keeps it out.
WIDE! Gabriel bowls it down the leg side, Kevin O'Brien lets it go.

Drinks break! West Indies have struck twice in quick succession. Stirling first and just the last ball before the break, Porterfield went. Gabriel has picked up both and is breathing fire in this spell. West Indies would love more. For Ireland though, Andy Balbirnie is still out there in the middle and his team would hope that he can get a big one. Kevin O'Brien joins him in the middle.

OUT! The skipper departs! This is exceptional bowling from Gabriel! On a length and landing on leg or just outside probably. The ball though moves away and angles away from the left-hander. Porterfield looks to tuck it on the leg side but gets an outside edge and the ball carries at a really good height to Ashley Nurse at second slip. He holds on and the poor run for Porterfield continues at his new position, one where he has never batted before. Thus, two quick strikes by Gabriel and West Indies. Can they restrict the Irish now?
On a length on off, pushed back towards the bowler by Porterfield.
Length delivery on middle, Porterfield nudges it towards square leg for a run. 7 runs have come from the over.
Length delivery on off, Balbirnie dabs it towards third man for a run.
FOUR! Excellent shot. That raced away. Full on leg, Balbirnie flicks it beautifully through square leg for a boundary.
Full again on middle, Porterfield drives it straight past the bowler towards mid on for a run.
Dead ball called... This was funny! Cottrell was running up to bowl but the ball slips on his run up just as he was loading to deliver. The ball hits his back and rolls towards the side of the pitch.
Full on middle, Porterfield drives it to mid on.
On a good length on middle, Porterfield looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad. Balbirnie wants the single but William Porterfield does the right thing in sending him back.
Full on leg, Balbirnie flicks it towards fine leg for a single. 5 runs and a wicket off this Gabriel over.
Good length delivery on middle, William defends it off the front foot.
On a length on off, Porterfield drives it to covers.
William Porterfield is the new batsman in.

OUT! Stirling holes out! He is frustrated and cannot believe it that he has thrown it away. A short ball on middle, Paul looks to pull but is not in control of the shot. He hits it high and the ball carries to deep fine leg where Cottrell moves a bit to his right and backwards before taking a safe catch. The massive partnership of 146 is broken and Windies have a chance to come back now with a few tight overs, having a new batsman at the crease. Stirling did make the most of his early reprieve but has to depart now. Also, the bowling change must be appreciated!
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and outside off, Stirling drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
On a good length on middle, Stirling defends it off the front foot.
Just one over for Chase. Shannon Gabriel comes back on now.
FOUR! Shot! Lifted over the head of extra cover. The ball is well away from the fielder in the deep. Once again a boundary to end the over.
On a length outside off, Stirling taps the ball on the off side and gets to the other end with a really quick single. Good communication between both batsmen this.
Pushed towards cover by the batsman.
Lofted aerially over covers for a single by Balbirnie. Safe shot as there was not enough on the ball to carry to deep cover.
Crunched through the covers but straight to the fielder in the deep. Only a single hence.
Fuller outside off, driven to deep cover for a single by Balbirnie.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on.
Flighted delivery on middle, Balbirnie sweeps it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends. 13 runs have come from the over. The Irish batsmen are dominating the West Indies bowlers here.
Tossed up on middle, Andy flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot. 150 comes up for Ireland. Short on off, Balbirnie makes room and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Full on middle, Paul drives it to long on for a run.
SIX! This is wonderful batting from Paul. Flighted delivery on off, Stirling lofts it over covers for a biggie. Paul Stirling is taking the attack to the opposition.
Tossed up on middle, Balbirnie flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Roston Chase to bowl now.
Good running! This ball on a length on middle is tucked around the corner through square leg. Couple of runs taken, very smart running.
Fuller on middle, Paul presents the full face of the bat and hits the ball to mid-wicket.
On the pads this time and fuller, Stirling looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads outside the leg stump line.
Run down to third man for a single this time by Balbirnie.
Pushed off the back foot towards cover by AB.
Fuller on off, driven towards cover by the batsman.
FOUR! Nice shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Stirling plays a sweep over short fine leg for a boundary. 15 runs have come from the over. Big over for Ireland.
Floated outside off, Stirling looks to defend but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man. The batsmen get two runs. There is no slip there.
Tossed up on middle, Balbirnie flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Powerful shot. Floated on middle, Balbirnie comes down the track and lofts it over long off for a biggie.
Tossed up on middle, Stirling nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Balbirnie sweeps it through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Paul defends it off the back foot.
On a good length on off, Paul keeps it out.
Full on off, Stirling drives it towards mid off where Sheldon Cottrell misfields but does not concede a single.
Paul Stirling having a change of willow here... probably the big shots are going to come now!
Flicked through mid-wicket for a run by the batsman.
Drive away from the body by Stirling. The ball goes uppishly through covers for a run to the deep.
Outside off on a length, dabbed down to third man for a run by Andy.
Loopy delivery on middle, Paul flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery on middle, Andy nudges it towards square leg for a run. The 100-run stand comes up between these two, what a brilliant partnership this has been!
Tossed up on off, Paul plays it towards point for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Andy comes down the track and plays it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Balbirnie sweeps it to square leg.
BEATEN! Tossed up outside off, Balbirnie looks to cut but misses it.
Driven through mid off by AB. Single taken and Balbirnie retains strike for the next over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Fuller one on the pads, beautifully driven by Stirling but Roach at mid on dives to his left and stops the ball. A single can't be prevented though.
Defended from the crease back to the bowler this time.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a couple of runs by Stirling.
On a length, pushed to deep cover for a single by Balbirnie.

FOUR! 50 for Paul Stirling. 19th fifty for him. This has been a fine innings from him. Amazing shot. Tossed up on off, Stirling lofts it over covers for a boundary. 13 runs have come from the over. Ireland getting a move on here.
SIX! Nice use of the feet and wrist. Tossed up on off, Stirling comes down the track and lofts it over extra cover for a maximum.
Short delivery on middle, Balbirnie pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
100 for Ireland. Tossed up on middle, Stirling drives it to long on for a single.
Full on off, Stirling drives it to mid off.
Floated outside off, Balbirnie makes room and plays it towards the off side for a run.
Eased through the leg side for a single by Balbirnie. Keeps strike for the next over.
AB has played it to the point region.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a couple of runs. Good placement as well as running by Balbirnie.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Driven but straight to mid on by PS.
Kept out towards cover-point by Stirling to this ball bowled on top of off.
Full on middle, Paul drives it towards mid on. The batsmen change ends. 6 runs have come from the over.

50 for Andy Balbirnie. 9th fifty for him. Excellent innings from him and he would like to convert this into a big one. Floated on off, Balbirnie plays it towards covers for a run to get to the landmark.

Short delivery outside off, Balbirnie makes room and cuts it through point. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it just before the ropes. The batsmen get two runs. They did not think about the third.
Full on off, Balbirnie drives it through covers. The batsmen get two runs.
BEATEN! Tossed up just outside off, Balbirnie looks to cut but misses it due to the spin on this one.
Flighted outside off, defended towards cover by Balbirnie.
Ashley Nurse now comes on.
On a good length on off, Stirling defends it out. Paul Stirling is struggling with his timing here.
Good length delivery on off, Paul defends it off the back foot.
On a length on middle, Balbirnie nudges it towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Balbirnie flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Balbirnie cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Full on middle, Balbirnie drives it to mid on.
On a good length on middle, Balbirnie looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Full and outside off, Stirling drives it through point for a run.
Good length delivery on middle, Stirling defends it off the back foot.
On a good length on off, Paul keeps it out.
Kept out watchfully by the batsman back down the ground.
On a length on the pads, Stirling looks to flick but misses the ball. Dot to start the over.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short of a length delivery, Balbirnie pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary. No stopping that one, got it really fine.
Full on middle, Balbirnie drives it to mid on.
Length delivery on middle, Stirling flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full on middle and leg, Paul nudges it to the leg side.
On a good length on leg, Stirling looks to defend but gets hit low on the pads.
Length delivery on middle, Balbirnie defends it towards the leg side and takes a quick run. Good running between the wickets.

Ireland did lose debutant and new opener, James McCollum early but ever since have gone solidly. The duo of Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling have added 58 runs and looked really good in the middle. Stirling seems to be making most of his second life that he got early on in the innings. Windies would need a wicket or the runs could start flowing soon. On the other hand, the hosts would love for this to continue. Holder to continue bowling after the break...
Good length delivery on off, Stirling defends it off the front foot.
On a good length on middle, Paul looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Short delivery on middle, Stirling pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, Stirling shoulders his arms to this one.
Length delivery on off, Stirling plays it to point.
On a good length on middle, Paul keeps it out.
Full on middle, Andy drives it to mid on. 2 runs from Holder's first over.
On a good length on off, Stirling dabs it towards third man where the fielder does well to stop it. The batsmen take a single.
Full on off, Stirling drives it to mid off.
On a good length on middle, Balbirnie offers a forward defense on this one.
Full on middle, Balbirnie drives it straight past the bowler towards mid on for a single.
On a good length on off, Balbirnie keeps it out.
Jason Holder is into the attack.

FOUR! Pulled off the front foot through mid-wicket. Short of a length on middle, Balbirnie pulls this through mid-wicket. The fielder is at deep square leg and cannot cut the ball. It also brings the 50-run stand between these two. A really good one. 6 runs off this Gabriel over.
Punched off the back foot towards extra-cover.
Solid-looking drive now from Balbirnie takes the ball to deep cover for a run.

Another ball that goes through Balbirnie. He is playing good shots but also missing a few. On a length outside off, shapes in after landing. Andy is trying to punch that from within the crease but is beaten by the movement as well as the low bounce on that occasion. Could have so easily been bowled.
Driven through off side with really good timing by Stirling. A single is taken.
On a length outside off, Stirling chops the ball but finds point.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Flighted delivery on leg, Balbirnie sweeps it towards fine leg for a boundary. 11 runs from the over followed by a maiden. Expensive over for West Indies.
Tossed up on off, Andy defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Tossed up on middle, Balbirnie sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Floated on off, Andy guides it towards third man. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on off, Andy plays it to point.
Tossed up on middle, Stirling comes down the track and flicks it towards wide mid on for a single.
On a good length and outside off, Balbirnie plays it to covers. Maiden from Shannon Gabriel.
Good length delivery outside off, Balbirnie shoulders his arms to this one.
Outside off, Balbirnie offers no shot.
Length delivery on off, Andy defends it from the back foot.
On a good length and outside off, Andy offers no shot.
BEATEN! That has cut Balbirnie in half. Gabriel bowls it on a good length on off, Andy Balbirnie looks to defend but misses it due to the sharp inswing on this one.
Shannon Gabriel is into the attack.
Punched off the back foot towards cover by Stirling. 5 runs off this over, Ireland moving quite smoothly now.
Flighted on middle and leg, Stirling pushes this ball back towards the bowler who moves slightly to his right and stop the ball.
Driven through the covers by AB. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball through covers. One run added to the total.
Saved three runs there! Flighted on middle and leg, Balbirnie sweeps it to the left of short fine leg where Gabriel dives and half-stops it. Excellent! A single is completed though.
Flatter on middle and leg, turned away through mid-wicket and the batsmen come back for two runs. Good running that. That double also brings up the 50 for Ireland.

Full on leg, Balbirnie looks to flick but gets it off his pads. It goes towards short fine leg. The batsmen take a run. The umpire gives it as a leg bye. 10 runs have come from the over. Much-needed one for Ireland.
Full on middle, Balbirnie drives it to mid on.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Andy. Short delivery on middle, Balbirnie pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Amazing shot from Andy Balbirnie. Short delivery on middle, Balbirnie pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The fielder had no chance there.
Length delivery on off, Stirling taps it towards point for a single.
On a good length and outside off, Stirling plays it to point.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single. 3 runs off Allen's first.
This time the push to the flighted ball goes to long on for a run.
Good stop that off his own bowling. Flatter on middle, Balbirnie pushes it to the right of the bowler where Allen dives and stops it. Prevents the single.
Driven to long off for a run now by Stirling.
Lovely loop on that ball, pushed back to the bowler by PS.
Flighted on middle, pushed back towards the bowler by Stirling.
Powerplay 2 time! 4 fielders can now be outside the circle till the end of the 40th over. Meanwhile, we have a change in bowling as well. Fabian Allen comes on.
Length delivery on middle, Balbirnie flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs. 3 runs from the over and Ireland are 36/1 after 10 overs.
Bowls a bumper, Balbirnie does well to duck under it.
Full on off, Balbirnie drives it to covers.
On a length on middle, Balbirnie nudges it to the leg side.

IN THE AIR BUT SAFE! Bowls a short of a length delivery, Stirling looks to pull but gets a top edge. Roach gets extra bounce on that one. It goes towards deep backward square leg where the fielder running from fine leg goes for the catch but it falls short of him. The batsmen take a single. Close shave this for Paul.
On a good length on off, Stirling defends it off the front foot.
On a length on the pads, flicked away through mid-wicket and a couple of runs are taken till the time Roston Chase mops up in the deep.
Punched off the back foot towards mid on by the batsman.
Good comeback this time. On a length outside off, Andy has to be watchful as he pushes this ball towards cover.
FOUR! Short ball attempted from Cottrell but not a good ball with short fine leg inside the circle. Balbirnie swivels and gets enough on that to take it over the man at 45. The ball reaches the rope.
Punched off the back foot towards cover.

Lovely shot but the outfield is heavy and hence the ball does not go to the boundary. On a length outside off, Balbirnie drives on the up through the right of mid off. Two runs collected as Holder gives chase.
Good length delivery on middle, Paul defends it from the front foot.
On off, Paul defends it out.
Good length delivery on middle, Paul keeps it out.

FOUR! Excellent shot. There was no need to run for that. Full on middle, Stirling drives it beautifully past the bowler for a boundary. This is the only second scoring shot of Roach's bowling for a boundary.
On a good length on middle, Stirling keeps it out.
On a good length on middle, Paul blocks it off his front foot. Nice delivery from Roach.
On a length, pushed to the right of the bowler with a straight bat by Balbirnie. Cottrell gets low to his right and puts a hand to stop the ball.
On a length on top of middle, kept out towards the offside by AB.
The batsman works it down the leg side through square leg. They pick up a single.

Ouch! That has got him in the box! A back of a length ball on middle, Stirling looks to pull but misses and gets hit near his crown jewels. That must have hurt but he seems to be okay to continue after gathering himself.
Back of a length on off, Stirling brings the bat high to defend it towards the left of the bowler. Extra-cover comes ahead and fields the ball.
Back of a length outside off, squeezed down to third man for a run by Balbirnie.

On a good length on middle, Paul blocks it off his back foot. Second maiden over for Kemar Roach and second maiden over in a row for West Indies. He has bowled 17 dot balls out of the 18 balls bowled. Excellent bowling from him.
Full on middle, Stirling flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a good length on off, Stirling blocks it well.
Good length delivery on middle, Stirling keeps it out.
On a good length on off, Paul blocks it off the back foot.
Roach bowls it on a good length and outside off, Stirling plays it to point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Bowls a fuller one on the pads, Andy looks to flick but fails to put bat on ball. Get hit on the pads but there is no appeal as the ball was landing outside leg.
Balbirnie confidently comes ahead and drives this ball on length towards mid off. No run though.
Back of a length outside off, pushed from the crease towards cover by the new batsman.
Andy Balbirnie is the new batsman in.

OUT! This time the ball takes the edge! Cottrell brings out his trademark salute celebration. On a length outside off and Sheldon takes the ball away from the batsman, McCollum looks to drive without foot movement and gets an outside edge that carries to the keeper behind. Easy catch for Hope and West Indies get the early breakthrough. An early end to the batting innings on his home ODI debut for McCollum.
Good ball! A play and a miss outside off to this ball on a length by Cottrell outside off.
FOUR! First run off Roach and it is a boundary. Roach strays down the leg side, tucked around the corner easily by Stirling for an easy boundary.
Solid defense this time, back of a length and kept out towards the bowler.
10 dot balls from Roach out of 10 balls bowled. Some bowling this, on a good line and length on top of off, PS just defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

DROPPED! That is a dolly that has been put down. On the pads, flicked uppishly and the ball goes straight towards Allen at square leg. Right into the midriff, a sitter that. He though cannot hold on and has a sheepish grin on his face. Roach will not be pleased. Could have had a wicket without conceding a run! Paul Stirling though would now look to make use of this chance.
On a length on leg stump, the ball is pushed back to the right of the bowler. 7 dots for Roach on a row now.
Length delivery on middle, Paul nudges it towards square leg for a run.
On a length on off, Stirling drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it. The batsmen wanted the third but decide against it. The batsmen get two runs.
Length delivery outside off, Paul plays it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Short and outside off, Stirling cuts it through point for a boundary.
On a length on off, McCollum dabs it towards third man for a run.
Maiden for Stirling to begin with. On a length on off, pushed back towards mid off.
Sprays this one on the pads, Stirling looks to angle it away on the leg side but fails to play his shot properly. The ball goes off the leading edge towards mid on.
Kept out on the front foot once more.
On a length and on the leg stump line, pushed towards mid on by Paul.
Fuller this time, Stirling comes ahead and defends the ball to cover.
Back of a length on middle, defended on the back foot by Stirling back on the surface.
Kemar Roach to bowl with the other new ball.
Full on off, James drives it to covers. 5 runs have come from the over. Good start for the West Indies.
Bowls a yorker on middle, James does well to dig it out.
Bowls a yorker on middle, McCollum keeps it out.
FOUR! First boundary of the match. On a good length and outside off, McCollum looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary.
On a good length on off, McCollum keeps it out.
Starts with a full delivery outside off, Stirling drives it but gets it of the outer half of the bat. It goes towards third man for a run. First run for Ireland.

Time for the first ball then. The Irish opening batsmen, James McCollum and Paul Stirling are out in the middle on a Malahide Cricket Club ground which is basking in beautiful sunshine. Surprise, surprise! Where will Porterfield bat now? Meanwhile, the Windies fielders are taking their positions as well. Sheldon Cottrell has the first new ball in his hand. Let's play!!!
The two teams are out in the middle for their respective national anthems. First up is the West Indies one, followed by the Irish anthem.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder tells us he is happy to be bowling, expecting moisture on the surface early on and some help for the pacers. When asked what they need to do post their loss to Bangladesh, Holder feels that improvement is needed, that's all and that they were a few runs short in the previous game, and that they need to maximise the last few overs with a set batsman being in. Informs that they have one change, Fabian Allen comes in for Shane Dowrich.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that he want to bat first because he thinks the surface will be decent to bat on but might slow down due to the amount of cricket played. He informs that it has not been the best of weeks with the two losses but they have worked hard and come back for this game. Signs off by informing that they have two changes, James McCollum and Boyd Rankin come in.

West Indies XI - Sunil Ambris, Shai Hope (WK), Darren Bravo, Roston Chase, Jonathan Carter, Jason Holder (C), Fabian Allen (IN FOR SHANE DOWRICH), Ashley Nurse, Kemar Roach, Sheldon Cottrell, Shannon Gabriel.

Ireland XI - William Porterfield (C), Paul Stirling, Andrew Balbirnie, James McCollum (IN FOR LORCAN TUCKER), Kevin O Brien, Gary Wilson (WK), George Dockrell, Mark Adair, Joshua Little, Boyd Rankin (IN FOR BARRY McCARTHY), Tim Murtagh.
TOSS - Ireland win the toss and elect to bat first.

Hello and welcome to the fourth ODI of this tri-nation series in Ireland. The only team without a win so far in this series, the hosts Ireland will be playing West Indies in a repeat of the initial game of the tournament. Back then, the hosts got thrashed by whopping margin of 196 runs courtesy the record opening partnership between John Campbell and Shai Hope of 365 runs. The former did miss his team's previous game against Bangladesh which they lost and it remains unknown if he will return today. On the other hand, Ireland, though they are not in the World Cup are a proud team and they will need 2 wins in their 2 games so that they can have a shot at being in the final. Their opposition today, the team from the Caribbean are not exactly a team that is consistent. When it rains, it flows for them and the two games of theirs so far have shown us exactly the same. The home team would hope that today is an off day for their much more experienced and much more fancied rivals, otherwise it looks tough for them to stop the West Indies from getting their second win on the board. The toss is not too far away...
